title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Urinary Calculus
intro: Herbal creams for Urinary calculus are topical preparations made from natural herbs and plants that are used to treat kidney stones or urinary calculi, a condition characterized by the formation of hard deposits in the urinary tract. Examples of herbal creams used to treat urinary calculus include Chanca piedra, which has been shown to prevent the formation of kidney stones, and Juniper berry, which helps to reduce inflammation and improve urine flow. Other herbal creams such as Celery seed, Corn silk, and Dandelion root are also used due to their diuretic and antispasmodic properties, which help to flush out the kidneys and alleviate symptoms associated with the condition.
